script: Astronauts cannot cry the normal way in space. Without gravity, tears do not run down their cheeks. Instead, they form a growing ball of water on the eye. It can sting, so astronauts have to wipe it away. In space, water clings together into floating spheres. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
